# Matheus Thurler Blog

> DevOps & Platform Engineer focused on Google Cloud, Infrastructure as Code, and Site Reliability Engineering.

## About

This is a bilingual (English/Portuguese) technical blog covering:

- Google Cloud Platform (GCP) tutorials
- Kubernetes & container orchestration
- Terraform & Infrastructure as Code
- CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
- Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)
- Platform Engineering
- AI/LLM integration in DevOps workflows
